title: Hybrid scope and editorial independence
requirement: Web Studio SHALL support visual-first, code-first and mixed authoring over one canonical content and publication system. A standard site and ordinary supported CMS edits SHALL require neither a custom repository nor developer involvement. An embedded IDE, hosted AI and arbitrary customer server execution are not prerequisites.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a standard qualified presentation
scenarios.when: a permitted editor creates a Page
scenarios.then: creation, preview and publication are possible without GitHub

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: GitHub is unavailable
scenarios.when: an editor saves supported content against an admitted presentation
scenarios.then: the content path does not call GitHub or fail solely because of that outage

title: Explicit amendments and evidence status
requirement: This capability SHALL preserve existing owners and distinguish verified code from unmerged intent. HA-A1 through HA-A4 SHALL be recorded as explicit later-phase planning amendments before incompatible behavior is implemented. Document completion SHALL NOT claim Built, Live, Confirmed or a passed runtime qualification.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an approved hybrid direction and unmerged Phase 23 contracts
scenarios.then: affected owner decisions and scenarios are reconciled with exact source versions

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a prototype conflicts with a frozen requirement
scenarios.when: an implementer considers the prototype convenient
scenarios.then: the conflict is resolved explicitly, not silently copied into production

title: Coherent software qualification
requirement: Production admission SHALL use one exact coherent qualified Payload/Next/React/toolchain cohort consistent with the governing major-line decision. Puck SHALL be pinned only after integration qualification. An internal pin, current stable v3, or vendor feature page SHALL NOT substitute for required v4 evidence or authorize an implicit downgrade.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a candidate supported cohort
scenarios.when: qualification exercises editor, transactions and public behavior
scenarios.then: exact versions, source and outcomes are retained

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the candidate cannot satisfy required engine semantics
scenarios.then: the dependent capability stays unavailable without raw-admin or alternate-major fallback

title: One physical write transaction
requirement: Acknowledged editorial save SHALL atomically commit its content, source revision, current lease/authority proof, receipt and any required dispatch intent in one qualified physical database transaction. Separate provider/API requests SHALL NOT be represented as atomic merely because they share an identifier.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized save with valid revision
scenarios.then: one transaction acknowledges the exact new revision

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the receipt write fails after a content write in the transaction
scenarios.then: all required writes roll back and Saved is not displayed

title: Stable semantic catalog identity
requirement: Every node SHALL use stable identity, exact semantic type and schema version. A single canonical versioned catalog SHALL supply compatible editor fields, public decoders, standard rendering and migration meaning. Unsupported fields and types SHALL not be silently dropped or inferred from filenames.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a known component file is renamed
scenarios.when: its stable registered identity is unchanged
scenarios.then: existing Pages keep their editable bindings

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: unknown semantic content arrives
scenarios.then: it returns a repairable incompatibility without silently omitting the node

title: Bounded composition successor
requirement: Ordinary Page composition v2 SHALL follow the exact Stack/Split/Grid grammar and finite settings in ux-and-composition.md, with two container levels, stable reading order and explicit admission limits. Articles and v1 Pages SHALL retain their qualified grammar. No arbitrary CSS, coordinates, script, viewport property bag or recursive layout is accepted.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a v2 Page and permitted split layout
scenarios.then: the server accepts it and the standard renderer preserves reading order

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a third container level or Article layout is submitted
scenarios.then: the command is rejected with the responsible node path and no data loss

title: One visual data adapter
requirement: The visual editor SHALL project from and translate back to the canonical Asym document. Its internal data/state SHALL NOT be a second persistent document authority. Equivalent untouched content SHALL round-trip with stable identity and no field loss under a pinned adapter.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a canonical fixture with all supported node kinds
scenarios.when: the real pinned visual adapter loads and saves without edits
scenarios.then: canonical equivalence and stable IDs are preserved

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an adapter omits a supported field
scenarios.then: qualification fails rather than migrating the loss into user documents

title: Explicit source-to-content bindings
requirement: Presentation manifests SHALL declare stable renderer keys, semantic versions, finite setting schemas and binding metadata. Developers SHALL preserve CMS-controlled values or declare an explicit compatibility change. Structural prop acceptance alone SHALL NOT be treated as proof of visible content control.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a custom hero consumes its declared headline
scenarios.when: staff change that field after a design update
scenarios.then: the actual rendered headline changes

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a developer hardcodes that value
scenarios.then: the broken control is diagnosed and the package cannot be admitted as compatible

title: Standard fallback and historical portability
requirement: Every admitted semantic/layout version SHALL have a qualified standard rendering path. Missing custom implementation SHALL follow explicit owner-qualified fallback or narrow unavailability, never silently lose content. Historical schema transformation SHALL not mutate stored history on read.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a current document has a standard compatible renderer
scenarios.then: content remains inspectable through its qualified standard path

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: no renderer supports the document version
scenarios.then: activation is blocked with compatibility repair rather than stripping content

title: Acknowledged saves and bounded recovery
requirement: The editor SHALL expose Unsaved, Saving, Saved and owner-caused failure truthfully. Save now and keyboard save SHALL flush without publication. Lost acknowledgement SHALL reuse the original idempotency identity or read its receipt before any successor write.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a valid local edit
scenarios.then: Saved identifies the acknowledged revision

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the response is lost after commit
scenarios.then: receipt/replay resolves the original effect once before another save

title: Session-owned lease and compare-and-swap
requirement: Every D12 mutation SHALL prove the exact resource scope, editing session, current lease generation and expected revision. Same-user tabs are separate sessions. Takeover SHALL checkpoint and fence the displaced editor atomically; coordination SHALL NOT replace permission or CAS.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a second authorized session
scenarios.when: it opens an actively edited resource
scenarios.then: it is read-only with permitted takeover guidance

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a displaced tab submits an old lease token
scenarios.then: the stale write is denied and unsent work remains available for comparison

title: Draft validation distinct from publication readiness
requirement: Structurally safe incomplete content SHALL be retainable as a private draft with actionable diagnostics. Authorization, schema-boundary, executable-payload or scope violations SHALL be rejected. Readiness failures SHALL block the relevant release rather than make all intermediate editing impossible.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a valid empty layout or required text not yet entered
scenarios.when: the editor saves a work in progress
scenarios.then: a private revision persists with completeness diagnostics

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a caller inserts arbitrary executable settings
scenarios.then: the server rejects the unsafe structure rather than retaining it as an executable draft

title: Usable visual composer with a non-drag path
requirement: The Asym composer SHALL provide outline, insertion, selection, movement, duplication, deletion, field inspection and finite layout controls. Every drag operation SHALL have keyboard and non-drag pointer equivalents with meaningful focus and announcements. Source identity SHALL survive reordering.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a keyboard or touch user
scenarios.when: they move a section using explicit controls
scenarios.then: the same canonical order changes and focus remains on the moved item

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: drag-and-drop is unavailable
scenarios.then: all required insert/move/remove tasks remain possible

title: Isolated composer and minimal bridge
requirement: The complete composer context SHALL run on the qualified isolated origin, receiving only admitted renderer code and the minimal authorized editorial projection. The trusted shell SHALL validate bridge source/origin/schema/nonce/scope and retain save/publication authority. Puck viewport isolation SHALL NOT be misrepresented as a security sandbox.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized isolated composer
scenarios.when: it submits a valid bounded edit intent
scenarios.then: the shell validates and sends the ordinary owner command

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an unknown origin or stale channel requests publication or broad data
scenarios.then: no privileged operation or disclosure occurs

title: Safe click-to-edit metadata
requirement: Editor source mappings SHALL identify authorized document/node/field references, not privileged tokens or mutable filenames as identity. Mapping SHALL be absent from public responses when it would disclose private editing information. Unknown or stale mappings SHALL fail safely.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an admitted component has current field metadata
scenarios.then: the matching allowed field opens without navigation loss

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: public output or a stale renderer references private editor context
scenarios.then: private metadata is excluded and stale selection cannot target another resource

title: Qualified media and links
requirement: Media and link controls SHALL use existing scoped identity/qualification services. Placements SHALL pin appropriate versions/renditions and preserve usage-local alt/crop/locale meaning. A caller-entered URL or cached selector result SHALL NOT bypass current rights, safety or destination authority.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: qualified media for the selected Site
scenarios.when: an editor places it with usage metadata
scenarios.then: preview and release bind the exact approved reference

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: rights are withdrawn during review
scenarios.then: the unsafe placement cannot become public even if the picker cache showed it

title: Bounded reusable sections
requirement: Reusable content SHALL remain explicit, exact Site/locale/family-qualified and nonrecursive under the approved reuse contract. The hybrid grammar SHALL allow reusable references only at its defined root positions. Impact views SHALL state completeness and never authorize deletion from a stale count.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a compatible root reusable section
scenarios.when: an editor selects its acknowledged revision
scenarios.then: the Page records an explicit reuse reference

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a cross-Site or nested recursive reference is attempted
scenarios.then: it is denied and no silent copy or wider grant is created

title: Exact independent locale lineages
requirement: Locale creation SHALL use the existing blank/copy-from exact revision operation with provenance and no ongoing synchronization. Public composition, source references and reviews SHALL request one exact locale without implicit language fallback. Source changes SHALL not overwrite translated work.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a translator starts from an exact source revision
scenarios.when: they edit the new private locale
scenarios.then: its later saves and publication are independent

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the original locale changes or a translation is missing
scenarios.then: no field fallback or automatic overwrite is introduced

title: Separate appearance and content axes
requirement: Per-instance settings SHALL be finite compatible fields on their owning editorial axis. Site-wide appearance SHALL use its existing separate owner and cohort semantics. Editing one SHALL NOT implicitly change the other, routes, navigation, money or operational facts.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an editor changes a local variant
scenarios.then: only that declared Page setting changes

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a Site-wide brand draft changes
scenarios.then: the brand draft is not implicitly activated or overwritten

title: Ministry-controlled source without supplier lock-in
requirement: Custom source SHALL be kept in a ministry-controlled conventional repository, with a supported project and maintainership/rights record. No Core fork, source-string CMS field or proprietary IDE state is required. Source control SHALL NOT imply ownership of dependencies or a standalone Asym platform.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a new qualified agency is appointed
scenarios.when: it uses the ministry project and documented SDK
scenarios.then: it can develop without the previous supplier controlling the repository

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: source export is requested
scenarios.then: actual source/assets/config rights and platform dependencies are distinguished

title: Dual-domain verified repository connection
requirement: Repository binding SHALL require current Asym integration authority and verified GitHub installation/repository authorization. Posted installation IDs, matching email, GitHub membership or repository URL alone SHALL NOT grant Asym access. Provider authentication SHALL not create a second Asym human permission system.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized ministry integration manager
scenarios.then: only the intended scoped binding activates

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an attacker substitutes an installation ID or callback state
scenarios.then: the binding is denied without repository disclosure

title: Minimal provider permissions and stable binding
requirement: A binding SHALL record stable provider repository identity, exact Tenant/environment/project/package location, state and epoch. Provider tokens SHALL be narrowly scoped and kept outside untrusted build execution. Initial source integration SHALL not request source-write, secrets, issue-creation or repository-administration access.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a repository is renamed without ownership change
scenarios.then: display metadata changes without creating a new project

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the App can see an unbound repository
scenarios.when: a request selects it without authorization
scenarios.then: it remains unavailable to that Asym project

title: Authenticated durable Git events
requirement: Git events SHALL validate raw-body signatures and schema, resolve known scoped bindings and persist accepted delivery identity/dispatch before acknowledgment. Delivery and business-effect deduplication SHALL be distinct; missed deliveries SHALL have bounded reconciliation.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a verified event for an active binding
scenarios.then: the stored event is acknowledged and recovered later

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a duplicate or out-of-order event arrives after revocation
scenarios.when: the handler and worker process it
scenarios.then: no duplicate effect or resurrected binding occurs

title: Exact bounded source intake
requirement: Source selection SHALL resolve once to immutable commit/tree and byte digests under an approved root. Intake SHALL reject traversal/expansion hazards and unsupported external source dependencies. Credentials and credential-bearing Git metadata SHALL be removed before untrusted execution.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a verified exact source revision
scenarios.then: the build receives bounded credential-free bytes with provenance

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: source contains an escaping symlink or unsupported external submodule
scenarios.then: capture fails explicitly rather than fetching arbitrary bytes or silently omitting files

title: First-class local and Git development
requirement: The developer project SHALL offer documented install/dev/test/build commands, exact SDK/toolchain requirements, synthetic fixtures and ordinary source history. The complete custom-source journey SHALL be possible using a supported external IDE and normal Git without Asym-hosted inference or IDE.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a developer has the supported toolchain
scenarios.when: they clone and follow documented commands
scenarios.then: they can run, test and submit a compatible package

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: no Asym browser IDE or AI credential exists
scenarios.then: no mandatory feature blocks the Git delivery path

title: Independent isolated clean builds
requirement: Qualification SHALL build exact captured source under an admitted frozen toolchain/dependency profile in isolated nonproduction execution. No production data, permanent provider token or serving-head authority is exposed. Mutable workspace output and customer-controlled CI SHALL not constitute independent approval.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: source passes its own tests
scenarios.when: the platform builds and checks the exact capture
scenarios.then: independent evidence binds the resulting artifact

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: source modifies its tests to pass or runs a hostile install script
scenarios.then: independent checks and isolation remain effective

title: Immutable admission and explicit first-party trust
requirement: An admitted package SHALL bind artifact/source digests, compatibility, settings/renderer manifest, dependencies/licenses, maintainer and qualified evidence. Admission SHALL be a distinct platform-owned decision. Signature, language types or test success alone SHALL not establish arbitrary-code safety.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: complete evidence passes under a known policy
scenarios.then: an immutable verdict identifies exactly the admitted bytes

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: repository administrators forge a passing status
scenarios.then: the missing independent admission blocks it

title: Separate server and editor builds
requirement: Public presentation SHALL preserve server-rendered essential content and the existing public view model; client editor configuration SHALL contain no server-only imports or authority. Editor and public builds SHALL prove compatible rendering/field bindings without forcing all public content into client rendering.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an admitted component has public and editor entrypoints
scenarios.when: both render the same contract fixture
scenarios.then: content meaning and binding behavior agree

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: client config imports a database or server secret module
scenarios.then: the package fails admission

title: Fixed complete authorized preview
requirement: An exact candidate SHALL seal complete deliberately selected inputs and reauthorize every preview request. It SHALL be private/no-store/noindex, side-effect-dark, candidate-local and complete-or-unavailable. Its identifier SHALL not grant access.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized user reviews a sealed candidate
scenarios.when: they navigate its Pages and links
scenarios.then: all output comes from the exact candidate closure

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a target is missing or access expires
scenarios.then: it fails privately rather than falling through to Live or causing real side effects

title: Newer work does not rewrite reviewed work
requirement: Later drafts or source commits SHALL not change an existing selected candidate. The UI SHALL identify excluded newer work and offer explicit successor preparation. Current safety/authority/cohort and required compatibility changes SHALL still be enforced before use and activation.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a candidate pins revision A
scenarios.when: an editor later saves revision B
scenarios.then: review remains A with B visibly excluded

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: candidate A loses required eligibility
scenarios.then: the safety/authority failure blocks A notwithstanding its earlier approval

title: Package availability distinct from activation
requirement: New executable presentation SHALL become available through the controlled managed runtime build/registry before dependent activation. Availability SHALL not make it public by itself. Required older renderers/assets SHALL remain available for active and retained generations.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a new admitted package is deployed into the registry
scenarios.then: current Sites retain their existing presentation

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a runtime lacks the selected required version
scenarios.then: readiness fails without substituting a different renderer

title: Single ordinary public publication owner
requirement: Content/composition release SHALL use D1 with exact compatible selections, current authority/safety, expected-head compare-and-swap and a durable receipt. Normal content edits SHALL not require a new Core code build. Tenant editorial policies SHALL not be replaced by a new blanket manual approval.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized compatible content edit
scenarios.when: the existing editorial policy permits publication
scenarios.then: D1 activates one coherent successor without rebuilding application code

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: two publishers race on the same expected head
scenarios.then: only a valid winning transition commits; no mixed generation appears

title: Complete-cohort design activation
requirement: Site presentation activation SHALL use D10 over every current public locale and qualified dispositions for enabled nonpublic locales. It SHALL reprove the exact cohort and expected heads and atomically change all required heads or none, without changing unrelated content or operational meaning.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: all locale candidates are ready and current
scenarios.then: the exact complete cohort advances together

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a locale is enabled or a head changes during review
scenarios.then: the stale cohort cannot partially activate

title: Restore creates a new valid successor
requirement: Editorial restore SHALL create a private draft successor; design restore SHALL use the existing new-successor process over current compatible content and current safety. Neither SHALL rewind history, reset content to a development snapshot or automatically reinstate an unsafe artifact.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a prior compatible design is requested
scenarios.then: a new current-content successor is activated with retained history

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the previous design is now safety-ineligible
scenarios.then: it is refused without weakening the adverse rule

title: Exact-revision scheduled operations
requirement: D13 appointments SHALL retain exact reviewed semantic intent, organization-owned authorization, civil/zone/offset/UTC data and generation-fenced lifecycle. Later autosaves SHALL remain excluded. Routine initiator offboarding SHALL not alone cancel organization intent; explicit invalidation SHALL prevent execution.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an appointment selects revision A
scenarios.when: revision B is saved and the initiator later leaves routinely
scenarios.then: only authorized A may execute under current organization rules

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an appointment is canceled or its safety authority invalidated
scenarios.then: it has no favorable public effect

title: One durable execution and scheduling substrate
requirement: Background work SHALL reuse shared product dispatch, claims and registered purpose-scoped workers. Identifier-only events SHALL not contain source/content/secrets. D13 SHALL retain the six-day handoff horizon and shared overdue recovery; Payload Jobs or per-Tenant schedulers SHALL not become publication authorities.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: committed work awaits executor delivery
scenarios.when: the shared executor retries after its dedupe window
scenarios.then: product receipt/claim still prevents duplicate effects

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a job requests full content or a secret in its envelope
scenarios.then: dispatch is rejected before external transmission

title: Versioned convergence and adverse priority
requirement: Derived cache/search/delivery state SHALL follow committed public generation receipts and current adverse rules. A delayed older event SHALL not restore withdrawn information. Convergence failure SHALL not undo an unrelated valid source write or imply source publication failed.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: D1 commits but a derived projection lags
scenarios.then: Published and convergence lag are distinct

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an old favorable update follows a current withdrawal
scenarios.then: the adverse filter wins and forbidden content is not re-exposed

title: Receipt-based retry and cancellation
requirement: Retryable effects SHALL have durable semantic identity and truthful accepted/running/succeeded/failed/canceled/unknown states where appropriate. Client or provider cancellation SHALL not be represented as undoing a committed effect. Unknown outcomes SHALL be reconciled before successor requests.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a worker response is lost after a durable effect
scenarios.then: the original receipt is resolved without duplication

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a user cancels after activation already committed
scenarios.when: the UI receives the authoritative outcome
scenarios.then: it reports the completed effect and offers its actual owner recovery, not false cancellation

title: Exact tenant and per-operation capabilities
requirement: Every product route, operation, bridge and worker SHALL derive current actor and scope from verified server context and enforce the owning capabilities. Role labels, GitHub membership and resource identifiers SHALL not widen access. Scope switches SHALL clear old-scope client state before rendering new data.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a permitted user has two Tenant assignments
scenarios.then: each tab/request binds its selected authorized scope

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: caller input supplies another actor or Tenant grant
scenarios.then: it rejects the forged authority and leaks no existence

title: Private Payload actor and service adapters
requirement: Human Payload operations SHALL pass the required exact actor/request/access/transaction context through the safe port, with access and editorial-lock bypass disabled. Registered service commands SHALL be narrower and independent. UI failure SHALL never reveal raw Payload Admin, accounts or APIs.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: an authorized human content command
scenarios.then: scoped access and lock/revision rules remain enforced

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: the custom editor crashes or a direct provider URL is guessed
scenarios.then: only a safe product state appears; no provider fallback grants access

title: Structural database integrity
requirement: Operational integration records SHALL use immutable trusted scope/attribution, same-scope keys, explicit legal states, appropriate uniqueness and noncascading retention. Exposed tables SHALL enforce both USING and WITH CHECK through tested grants/RLS. Private adapters SHALL not create parallel permission semantics.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a legitimate scoped relationship is written
scenarios.then: only the valid same-scope relationship commits

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an allowed row is updated into another Tenant or with forged ownership
scenarios.then: constraints/policy deny the transformation

title: Controlled integration disconnection and replacement
requirement: Disconnection/repository control changes SHALL fence new dependent source work and require re-verification to reconnect. Routine provider outage SHALL not be treated as deletion. Retained licensed compatible safe artifacts SHALL continue ordinary CMS operation under existing owner policies.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: the ministry replaces its developer or source binding
scenarios.when: new verified binding is prepared before switch
scenarios.then: source history and ongoing editorial content are preserved

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a stale event arrives after disconnection
scenarios.then: the old binding cannot regain authority

title: Explicit safe migrations
requirement: Catalog/schema/settings changes SHALL use an owner-approved no-write plan and fresh authorized commit to private successors where needed. Current content SHALL not be replaced by development snapshots. Mixed-version readers/writers, partial backfills and rollback/roll-forward SHALL have tested outcomes.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a reviewed property migration is required
scenarios.when: the approved plan commits against expected revisions
scenarios.then: private compatible successors preserve original history

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an editor changes a row after migration planning
scenarios.then: that conflict is surfaced rather than overwriting the edit

title: Bounded resources and privacy-safe evidence
requirement: Intake, build, preview, editing and public rendering SHALL use a qualified numeric profile with fairness, backpressure and hard resource limits. Observability SHALL record safe identity/cause/outcome/timing without source, content, secrets or restricted facts in generic telemetry.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: several tenants submit valid bounded builds
scenarios.then: fair queues and limits preserve unrelated safe service

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: an oversized source or runaway script appears
scenarios.then: it is contained and diagnosed without leaking content or starving other tenants

title: Retained artifacts and preview expiry
requirement: Expiry SHALL revoke preview access and disposable compute without deleting acknowledged source/content or required receipts. Artifact/media removal SHALL require complete current use, rights and retention evidence; age alone SHALL not authorize purge of admitted versions.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a preview expires
scenarios.then: private access stops while required editorial/release state survives

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a supposedly unused artifact has incomplete use evidence
scenarios.then: purge is blocked rather than trusting a stale zero count

title: External coding-agent optionality
requirement: External agents MAY assist within the developer’s permitted project and provider arrangements. Their instructions SHALL not grant Asym authority, disclose restricted context or bypass independent admission. No hosted model account or agent session is required for this release.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a developer uses an external agent on synthetic fixtures
scenarios.then: the normal tests and admission apply

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: generated code requests publication or operational secrets
scenarios.then: the request is denied regardless of agent instructions

title: Proven staff and developer handoff
requirement: Release acceptance SHALL demonstrate that staff can perform the agreed visual/content tasks after custom source changes and that a replacement developer can operate the supported project. Instructions SHALL identify maintenance, rights, safe previews, compatibility and source/config/content export limits.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: a nontechnical staff participant receives the site
scenarios.when: they create a Page and update content after a custom redesign
scenarios.then: the declared tasks succeed without code or developer intervention

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a new developer has only the authorized project and docs
scenarios.then: no internal Core source or hidden privileged credential is required

title: Independent complete release evidence
requirement: Acceptance SHALL include owner-level contract tests, real database/authorization/concurrency, actual pinned editor adapter, real browser/SSR/preview, source/build security, migration, accessibility and production-shaped capacity tests. Structural document tests SHALL not be reported as implementation or provider proof.

scenarios.name: Expected journey
scenarios.given: all required implementation proofs pass with exact versions
scenarios.then: only the proven profile is activated

scenarios.name: Adverse or boundary journey
scenarios.given: a mandatory provider, migration or real-browser test is skipped
scenarios.then: the dependent capability remains unqualified and the omission is not renamed a pass
